function.name: introduction_greet
function.description: Generate a greeting message introducing a person and their relationship to another individual. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

name.description: The name of the person being introduced.

relationship.description: The type of relationship to the related person.

related_person.description: The name of the person to whom the first person is related.

include_relationship.description: A flag to indicate whether to include the relationship in the greeting message.

message.content: I don’t “know” people in the way humans do—my knowledge comes from text data up until my last update (June 2024). If there’s something specific about a Daniel you'd like information on—or if you’d like me to generate a friendly intro for him—I’m happy to help!

Since it's ambiguous if they refer to someone named Daniel known personally. As an AI I don't have personal acquaintances but could say I do not personally know individuals unless context given.

We might also offer help with generating greeting via function if needed. But likely just answer straightforwardly. Let's reply politely.
